description: Fen looks navigationally perplexed while keeping both feet planted with map and stylus secure. The shoulders rise in a clear shrug, the stylus hand scratches the side of the head without releasing it, the eyes widen, the mouth opens slightly in surprise, and the tail tip curls uncertainly. One short turquoise route glow on the open map forks into two harmless directions, hesitates, and retracts without forming punctuation, text or a symbol; no walking or sadness. The emotion must read immediately as genuinely surprised and thoughtfully confused, never sad, ashamed, angry or mocking.

Fen's brows rise, mouth opens and tail pauses in a surprised curve as the gaze moves route-to-route. Both glows fade without altering any line, symbol or label.

Give the clip one dominant readable acting idea, a clean silhouette and clear negative space. Do not fall back to generic head scratching, broad arm waving or any gesture from an earlier take. No walking, stepping, running, hopping, pacing, dancing, sliding, turning away, camera motion, fade-out, dissolve, disappearance, shrinking, scene transition or end card.
